description: Read-only side passed to work: `aborted`, `reason`, the `'abort'` event and `throwIfAborted()`.
A signal that aborts itself after `ms` with a `TimeoutError`. No timer to manage.
A signal that aborts when any input aborts, carrying that input's reason. Combines deadlines, client disconnects and shutdown.
A signal only stops code that checks it. Pass it to every call that accepts one and listen to it in your own primitives.
`error.name` of the rejection: the deadline passed, or someone cancelled on purpose.
